description: Fetch test scenarios from the TestChimp platform by ordinal id (numeric part of TS-<n>) and/or external TMS ids (e.g. C12345, PROJ-101 — server strips prefixes and matches numerical part). Returns full plan markdown content, title, platform file path, linked user story ordinal ids, and external_source / external_system_id when present. Use when plan files are not yet synced to the repo, or when linking imported tests to scenarios by TMS id.
name: get-test-scenarios
